themes_detail.label: Electrical hazards surge
themes_detail.summary: Electrical complaints spiked to 5 this week compared to a baseline of 0.4 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 1,233% increase (z-score: 6.65)—suggesting either a widespread infrastructure failure or a newly recognized hazard in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights requiring urgent investigation.
evidence: 5 electrical complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 6.65 indicates statistically anomalous spike
Type of electrical issue (outages, exposed wiring, grid failure) not yet specified in complaint data
reporting_angles: Contact Con Edison for service alerts or infrastructure maintenance work in CD 310 this week
Interview residents with electrical complaints to identify geographic cluster (e.g., specific blocks or buildings)

themes_detail.label: Homeless encampments triple
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints jumped to 8 this week versus a baseline of 1.1 per week—a 611% spike (z-score: 4.07)—indicating a rapid emergence or visibility increase of street homelessness in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights, aligned with the community board's repeated requests for homeless services.
evidence: 8 encampment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 4.07 indicates high statistical significance
Chronic community board budget request for 'homeless services' suggests unresolved systemic issue
reporting_angles: Map this week's 8 encampment complaints to identify hotspot neighborhoods within Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights
Interview Department of Homeless Services about triggers for this week's spike and available outreach capacity

themes_detail.label: Abandoned bikes pile up
themes_detail.summary: Abandoned bike complaints jumped to 5 this week from a baseline of 0.8 per week—a 567% spike (z-score: 4.39)—suggesting either a bike-share or dockless scooter problem or organized dumping in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights public space.
evidence: 5 abandoned bike complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
No prior local news coverage suggests this is emerging, not a known chronic issue
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Parks and Department of Sanitation to determine if a specific bike-share or dockless vendor is abandoning equipment
Scout affected blocks to visually document accumulation and assess public nuisance severity

themes_detail.label: Park maintenance and noise complaints
themes_detail.summary: Two park-related spikes emerged last week: Maintenance/Facility complaints up 189% (13 vs. 4.5 weekly average, z-score: 3.8) and Noise in Parks up 500% (3 vs. 0.5 weekly average, z-score: 3.54), suggesting deteriorating park conditions or event activity in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights.
evidence: Maintenance/Facility complaints: 13 last week vs. 4.5 weekly average (189% increase, z-score: 3.8)
Noise - Park complaints: 3 last week vs. 0.5 weekly average (500% increase, z-score: 3.54)
Community board has standing request for 'reconstruct or upgrade building in a park' suggesting known infrastructure gaps
reporting_angles: Identify which parks (Owl's Head, Shore Road, etc.) generated the maintenance and noise complaints last week
Interview Parks Department about staffing levels and any recent events or maintenance deferrals in Bay Ridge parks

themes_detail.label: Building code violations and development pressure
themes_detail.summary: While not an acute 311 spike, 428 DOB permits filed in 90 days (363 alterations, 15 full demolitions) combined with two active ULURPs suggest significant construction activity and code compliance risk; correlated with community board's repeated 'other capital budget request for DOB' indicates unresolved inspection or enforcement capacity.
evidence: 428 total DOB filings in past 90 days, with 363 alterations suggesting high renovation activity
15 full demolitions filed, potentially signaling displacement pressure or neighborhood transformation
Two active ULURPs (9201 4th Ave, 9818 Fort Hamilton Parkway) in pipeline requiring zoning changes
Community board's repeated budget request for 'DOB capital' suggests inspection or enforcement backlogs
reporting_angles: Analyze demolition permits filed in past 90 days to identify if they cluster around ULURP sites or reveal speculation pattern
Request DOB enforcement data (violations, complaints, closures) for CD 310 to assess compliance challenges in active market
